name: Handwritten Maths
description: Maths written by hand on lined paper: order of operations, a column addition, a linear equation, stacked fractions, a power and a square root, and a word problem in messy block capitals. The handwriting is a jittered single-stroke pen generated by code, so no image exists anywhere else. The model has to read every digit correctly and then compute a single integer.
author: Gauntlet Core

cases.prompt:
The image shows a handwritten arithmetic problem. Work it out using the usual order of operations (multiplication and division before addition and subtraction).

Give the final answer as a single integer (digits only, no words or units). Give exactly one answer. If you give more than one answer, it will be marked wrong.
cases.notes: [standard] Written: 59 + 15 × 6 = ?. Answer 59 + 90 = 149 (left-to-right evaluation would give 444). Generated by verification/vision/handwriting.mts (seed 13001, hand 13101).

cases.prompt:
The image shows a handwritten column addition whose result has not been filled in yet. What is the sum of the three numbers?

Give the final answer as a single integer (digits only, no words or units). Give exactly one answer. If you give more than one answer, it will be marked wrong.
cases.notes: [standard] Written numbers: 8252 + 7207 + 5221 = 20680. Generated by verification/vision/handwriting.mts (seed 13002, hand 13102).

cases.prompt:
The image shows a handwritten equation with one unknown, x. Solve it: what is the value of x?

Give the final answer as a single integer (digits only, no words or units). Give exactly one answer. If you give more than one answer, it will be marked wrong.
cases.notes: [standard] Written: 8x − 7 = 7x + 4. Then 1x = 11, so x = 11. Generated by verification/vision/handwriting.mts (seed 13003, hand 13103).

cases.prompt:
The image shows a handwritten expression with two stacked fractions inside brackets, multiplied by a whole number. What is its value?

Give the final answer as a single integer (digits only, no words or units). Give exactly one answer. If you give more than one answer, it will be marked wrong.

The image shows a handwritten expression with a power (a small raised exponent), a square root and a division sign. Work it out using the usual order of operations.

Give the final answer as a single integer (digits only, no words or units). Give exactly one answer. If you give more than one answer, it will be marked wrong.

The image shows a handwritten word problem in capital letters. Solve it.

Give the final answer as a single integer (digits only, no words or units). Give exactly one answer. If you give more than one answer, it will be marked wrong.
cases.notes: [standard] Written: "A BAKER MAKES 14 TRAYS OF 14 ROLLS. SHE SELLS 147 ROLLS AND SHARES THE REST EQUALLY BETWEEN 7 BAGS. HOW MANY ROLLS GO IN EACH BAG?" → 14 × 14 = 196 rolls; 196 − 147 = 49 left; ÷ 7 = 7. Messier hand than the other cases, but every character stays legible. Generated by verification/vision/handwriting.mts (seed 13006, hand 13106).
